correctness.rationale: The complete algebraic classification uses p1=p2=0, Newton identities, and the conjugate reciprocal polynomial identity. Every six-node design splits into two equilateral triples, whose cyclic unit-length tangent edges close to a convex hexagon with no collinear consecutive edges. Direct signed shoelace yields the area formula. The third moment inversion is valid for 0<β<2π/3; the triple-angle factorization gives exact best quadratic coefficients. Boundary values and nonattained sharp limits are treated. 10,919 finite corroborative checks passed using included standalone code.
